topics.label: Lecture Introduction and Learning Outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer introduces the session by connecting histopathology practicals to cellular changes, outlining the historical background, and detailing the lecture's learning outcomes.

topics.label: Tumor Viruses and Experimental Models of Cellular Transformation
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how the investigation of transforming viruses revealed cellular proto-oncogenes and established experimental methods for demonstrating cell transformation.

topics.label: Concepts and Mechanisms of Oncogenes and Tumor Suppressors
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics define oncogenes and tumor suppressor genes and explain the molecular mechanisms through which their mutations disrupt cell cycle regulation.

topics.label: Genetic Instability and Multistep Tumor Progression
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore how defects in DNA repair, replication, and mitosis generate genetic instability to accelerate multistep tumor development.

topics.label: Hereditary Cancer Predispositions and Tumor Evolution
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics address hereditary cancer predisposition syndromes, illustrating how inherited mutant alleles accelerate tumor development and influence malignant evolution.

topics.label: Lecture Conclusion and Recommended Reading
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer concludes the presentation by reviewing the learning outcomes, offering recommended reading, and inviting questions before the next lecture.
